doc.title: Frank Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 7, 1998

title: What his high school band earned
summary: The 12-piece band got about $30 for a prom, with Foster taking three to five dollars.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Before we get out of your high school days, can you remember what your own band would have charged for let’s say a high school prom?
Let’s see. There was 12 members, I think a maximum of about $30.
Right $30. Which means that I would make about $5, $3 to $5, and the rest of the band would make $2 a piece.
It doesn’t seem like much nowadays, but you were probably glad to do it back then, right?
Yeah. Well in 1946 that was pretty good for a bunch of kids.
